d: Great hall in the palace of Damascus adorned with military trophies, destined for the meetings of the royal council, illuminated in time of night; throne on one side with steps covered with rich carpets, pillows around the Satrapi. Armida, and Rinaldo.
Idrenus following Satrapi, and Guards, and sayings.

Place near Damascus, where rises a high mountain covered with ice and snow, with cliffs on the front. Along its difficult and disastrous ascent there are scattered different, and robust plants all whitening with snow. Time is in the dawn. At the opening of the scene are seen Ubaldo, and Clotarco on horseback, with numerous followers of Soldati part on horseback and part on foot advancing in order of battle.
Zelmira, which descends from the mountain following Donzelle, then Clotarchus.

Mosaic atrium corresponding to the garden of Armida: in perspective the large door of the same silver construct, effigyed to low reliefs with hinges, and golden frames: on one side source composed of groups of rivers, which from their urns flow clear waters. Idreno, and Armida.
Rinaldo, and Armida, who followed him crying, and saddened.
Ubaldo, who stops observing and sayings.
Rich toilet in the royal palace, adorned with porcelain, gold, and silver, rubies, emeralds, and other gems. Idreno, and Zelmira.

Very pleasant garden with avenues, and bushes of flowers, several fruit trees, fountains, statues of alabaster, and of bronze, and seats of vegetables around. Large staircase in prospect, and in greater distance discovered between the interweaving of the above-mentioned avenues the magnificent real palace. Idreno with follow of Soldiers.
Ubaldo: the dancers and the nymphs disappear at his appearance.
Camping of Europeans near Damascus, where the Fanti are deployed, and waited on the hill, and the cavalry on the floor. View of a part of the city. Rinaldo, and Ubaldo.
Armida hasty with followers of Guards, and sayings.

Underground illuminated by lamps with different lights with all the instruments around, and symbols of magic, and divinatory art. Stone ara in the middle dedicated to the underworld gods. At the opening of the scene to the sound of funeral symphony are seen appear Zelmira, and Chained Clotarch, crowned with cypress branches, and surrounded by blindfolds decorated with symbols, and characters, preceded by the ministers of the temple, who carry the instruments of sacrifice, and are followed by Guards, then Armida, and Idreno in a dress of wishing with the tiara in chief, preceded by several Magicians carrying bright doubular hands, and followed by the Royal Custodians.
Courtyard in the royal palace. Idreno with a tail of soldiers, then Ubaldo followed by his own.
Zelmira, then Ubaldo, and Idreno between the Guards.
Rinaldo, holding Armida by the hand.
Magnificent palace of Armida, that then ruins, and turns into a desert countryside, in which you see several monsters. Zelmira, then Idreno chained between the Guards, and Armida.
Armida, Zelmira, Clotarch, and then Zelmira again.
